messages:
Maya (CS): ok team — need a quick alignment on the QBR pack for Northbridge. Exec wants a 6-slide narrative + 3-min demo. who can own the demo flow and the single-slide exec-one-pager?
Elliot (CSM): I can draft the one-pager. will pull renewal flags and top-3 wins.
Sam (Eng): I can own the demo, but need the latency / success metrics from Kiran. demo needs stable sample data.
Kiran (SE): sending the latest perf numbers now. note: we have a minor latency variance on P95 from last week — want to surface it as a risk or hide?
Maya (CS): surface it as a known risk with mitigation steps. execs prefer transparency + a clear ask (budget/ops).
Lisa (RevOps): I'll add a renewal RAG column and stitch in ARR signals. can someone confirm current contract renewal date for Northbridge?
Elliot (CSM): renewal is 2026-09-15. there are three seats in negotiation, leaning neutral.
Sam (Eng): pasted sample cmd used in demo: `curl -X POST https://demo.example/api/generate -d '{"prompt": "search: invoice 2025"}'` — will replace with real customer context once we have sanitized data.
Kiran (SE): uploaded perf snapshot to the drive: https://drive.redwood/example/perf-northbridge — use P50/P95 + error rate slide. also adding a note about fallback routing behavior.
Maya (CS): good. action items: 1) Elliot: one-pager draft by EOD Wed, 2) Sam: demo script & dry-run Thu AM, 3) Lisa: renewal RAG + ARR slide by Wed EOD, 4) Kiran: final perf numbers and short blurb for risk slide by Wed noon.
Elliot (CSM): ack. will ping with the draft link when ready.
Sam (Eng): ack for dry-run Thu 9:30am PT — can we block 30 min?
Kiran (SE): will update drive by 11:30am Wed.
Lisa (RevOps): booked a 30-min rehearsal slot Fri 10am PT in the calendar (invite sent).
Maya (CS): also want to capture enablement asks — recommend adding 1 slide with "Customer blockers + required partner actions". keep it short.
Elliot (CSM): adding a tiny checklist for enablement: sandbox creds, demo dataset, SSO screenshot.
ops-bot: Reminder: QBR pack deadline in 72 hours — please upload final slides to /QBRs/Northbridge. :bell:
Maya (CS): last ask — who will lead the exec intro? Elliot or me?
Elliot (CSM): I can intro, Maya will handle handoff into demo. :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): perfect. thanks all — i'll follow up with the consolidated slide deck link and final action tracker after lunch.
Sam (Eng): quick note — if we need a fallback shorter demo (2-min), I can prepare a condensed script.
Elliot (CSM): great idea. please add as an appendix slide.
Maya (CS): thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen if anything blocks.
